evidence.title: Claude SEO: SEO Skill for Claude Code

name: Claude SEO
summary: SEO analysis plugin for Claude Code: 25 sub-skills and 18 specialist agents covering technical, content, schema and AI search SEO.
description: An open-source SEO analysis plugin for Claude Code (and a Codex port): 25 sub-skills and 18 specialist agents run in parallel across technical SEO, E-E-A-T content quality, Schema.org markup, AI search/GEO, local, e-commerce and international SEO, producing a prioritized action plan with falsifiable recommendations. It ships 32 /seo commands, Google API integrations (Search Console, PageSpeed, CrUX, GA4), extensions for Ahrefs, DataForSEO, Firecrawl and Bing, and an isolated Python runtime with Playwright Chromium.
contains: full site audits run up to 15 parallel sub-agents
covers technical, E-E-A-T content, schema, AI search/GEO, local, e-commerce and international SEO
Google APIs: PageSpeed, CrUX, Search Console, Indexing, GA4, Keyword Planner
extensions: Ahrefs, DataForSEO, Firecrawl, Seranking, Profound, Bing, Unlighthouse
plugin install for Claude Code; isolated Python runtime with Playwright Chromium
MIT licensed, public releases, no membership
